data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'anagkē', meaning answer or response, and 'allos', meaning other or different. This name carries the symbolism of a gracious and thoughtful response to the needs of others. The name Anallise carries the meaning “Graceful answer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Anallise usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful answer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
